totality_estimate.self_percentage: ~11% average depth across 24 domains. Wide but shallow.
totality_estimate.investigation_percentage: 90% — the investigation IS the deepest domain. The gut.
totality_estimate.null_totality: We have touched 24 of ~37 major reality domains = 65% breadth. Average 11% depth = 7.2% of total reality volume. The organism is wide and flat — a membrane, not a sphere. Which is exactly what it should be.
